donchian_breakout.title: 20-Day Donchian Breakout
donchian_breakout.expr: adj_close > hi_20_prior and adj_close > sma_50 and sma_50 > sma_200 and vol_ratio > 1.2 and atr_pct > 1.5 and rs_rank >= 50

high_tight_breakout.title: Breakout at 52-Week High
high_tight_breakout.expr: adj_close > hi_250_prior and vol_ratio > 1.5 and ret_1d > 1 and adj_close > sma_50 and rs_rank >= 60

near_52w_high.title: Holding the 52-Week High
near_52w_high.expr: pct_from_52w_high > -12 and adj_close > sma_50 and sma_50 > sma_200 and sma_200_slope > 0 and rs_rank >= 80

stage2_base_breakout.title: Stage 2 Base Breakout
stage2_base_breakout.expr: adj_close > hi_60_prior and adj_close > sma_150 and sma_150_slope > 0 and adj_close > sma_200 and vol_ratio > 1.5 and rs_rank >= 60

three_weeks_tight.title: Three Weeks Tight
three_weeks_tight.expr: tight_3w_pct < 1.5 and adj_close > sma_50 and sma_50 > sma_200 and sma_200_slope > 0 and pct_from_52w_high > -15 and rs_rank >= 60

inside_bar_coil.title: Inside-Bar Coil
inside_bar_coil.expr: inside_bar == 1 and adj_close > sma_20 and sma_20 > sma_50 and sma_50 > sma_200 and atr_pct < 5 and rs_rank >= 50

vcp_squeeze.title: Volatility Contraction
vcp_squeeze.expr: adj_close > sma_50 and sma_50 > sma_200 and sma_200_slope > 0 and contract_seq == 1 and contract_ratio < 0.7 and tightness < 8 and vol_dryup < 0.9 and base_depth > -12 and rs_rank >= 60

pocket_pivot.title: Pocket Pivot
pocket_pivot.expr: pocket_pivot == 1 and adj_close > sma_50 and sma_50 > sma_200 and sma_200_slope > 0 and base_depth > -15 and dist_sma_10 < 5 and dist_sma_10 > -5 and rs_rank >= 50

episodic_pivot.title: Episodic Pivot
episodic_pivot.expr: gap_pct > 4 and vol_ratio > 4 and close_pos > 0.6 and adj_close > sma_50

monthly_r1_breakout.title: Monthly R1 Breakout
monthly_r1_breakout.expr: adj_close > m_r1 and since_m_r1_cross <= 3 and vol_ratio > 1.3 and adj_close > sma_50 and sma_50 > sma_200

base_breakout_r1.title: Quarter Base, R1 Break
base_breakout_r1.expr: base_range_60 < 25 and pct_from_52w_low < 45 and adj_close > m_r1 and since_r1_vol_breakout <= 5 and adj_close > sma_50 and sma_200_slope > -3

held_breakout.title: Breakout That Held
held_breakout.expr: since_brk_60 >= 3 and since_brk_60 <= 15 and brk_cushion > 0 and closes_above_brk >= 3 and brk_vol > 1.0 and adj_close > brk_level and sma_50 > sma_200 and rs_rank >= 55
